notes:
A350 and 777:
• New: Film player controls: pause, back and forward 10 seconds, progress and time.
• New: The animated welcome plays on seat screens while boarding, and the arrival scene after landing.
• New: Duty free is redesigned: one large item with Add to bag and four more beside it. The crew sees what is in the bags.
• New: Screen settings on every seat: its own second language and brightness.
• New: Zoom in and out on the close-up map.
• New: Music covers feature on tap, and More pages through every film and playlist.
• Improved: The map draws coasts and land while the imagery loads or with no internet.
• Improved: One consistent type scale, corner radii and shadow across every page. The menu arrives in order.
• Improved: Before landing, the destination page says what time to set your watch to.
A350:
• New: The crew panel's AirShow and IFE pages come with the seat screens alone, without the cabin lighting.
• New: Crew controls for cabin rest (Auto, Rest now, Lights up) and all window shades (Open all, Close all).
• Improved: The crew panel shows the real seat plan for the A350-900, A350-1000 and ULR, the announcement on the screens (automatic ones too) and whether the Cabin app runs.
• Improved: Meal and duty-free orders per zone, with Served and Delivered buttons that light up while orders wait.
777:
• New: Automatic cabin announcements. Orders are served by themselves after a while.
